environment: Development only; production was not modified
behavioralVerification: Built-in browser used for Admin editing, article visibility, publication changes, provenance and restored content. The content deployment command was used to perform the corresponding development imports; no automated test suite was run.

checks.observed: Preview reported four creates without writing. Apply imported the four English starter articles. Admin displayed their repository keys, source revisions, hashes and import timestamps.
A second deployment reported zero changed and four unchanged. No additional repository article cards appeared.

The browser showed four repository articles and two pre-existing manual articles, including the private draft. The customer view excluded that draft. A manual article with a matching title remained independent.

Edited Getting started through Admin and saved a temporary verification paragraph. The next deployment preview reported one conflict and three unchanged, exited with status 2 and did not overwrite the edit.

Explicit database resolution preserved the browser-authored content and displayed Approved database override. A subsequent preview treated all four articles as unchanged. The customer article still contained the accepted edit.
Explicit repository resolution restored the original body. The browser body matched the original repository article exactly; the temporary paragraph and override indicator were absent.

Temporarily deployed using-references with published false. Admin retained it as a draft and the customer list excluded it. Restored the source flag to true, deployed again and verified it reappeared for customers. All starter source files end in their original intended published state.

Four repository article cards, two manual article cards, zero approved override indicators and zero private draft cards in customer help. Screenshots capture the imported article in Admin and customer help.
